identity: A student shopping street and market district near Taichung First Senior High School, not a single civic building.

officialPages.evidence: Official identity, street vendors, shopping lanes and student district.
Official city article with Yizhong street photograph.

officialPhotos.visualInspection: Direct photograph inspected in own Chrome tab. A narrow street between mixed-height shopfronts; layered projecting signs, red/yellow food counters, left-side clothing racks, gray apartment walls/ACunits above, pedestrians occupy the open center.
Additional official indexed photo:market-lane string lights and small tables. Indexed visual description only, not directly viewed.

distinguishingMotifs: An open pedestrian street gap framed by two dense rows of low shopfronts, with ordinary taller city buildings behind.
Projecting horizontal signboards mixed with narrow vertical sign stacks; uneven heights rather than identical repeated kiosks.
Warm red/yellow food-stall fronts beside cool white/blue illuminated retail signs.
Shallow awnings, street counters and clothing racks create the close-grained student shopping character.
Keep the center lane visibly walkable; use a few pedestrians and hanging lights as supporting rhythm.
materialColors: Warm scarlet, yellow and cream stall faces
pixelPriorities: Make a compact street vignette, not a giant roofed hall.
Group signs into clean large pixel blocks; original generic lettering can suggest shops without copying brands.
avoid: Temple, castle, civic palace or one monumental shopping gate
Illegible text noise filling every pixel
Using a food-court photo as if it represented the entire district
rights: Reference links only. Do not copy source photographs into shipped game art. Draw original pixel interpretations.
